meta.note: Motion values. Read with motion.md, which says when to use each. Values come from meddle.studio production CSS and JS unless marked as a decision.

expo.use: The signature curve. Theme changes, underline draws, reveals, galleries. It moves hard at first and then settles slowly: confident, unhurried.

standard.use: Small UI state changes: pill hover colors, tooltip fades.

in-out.use: Things that leave and come back: nav hiding on scroll down and returning on scroll up.

quick.use: Nav show/hide, pill transitions, press feedback release.

moderate.use: Gallery open/close, short reveals of labels.

slow.use: Theme crossfade between dark and light sections.

reveal.use: Scroll reveals for headings and list items.

statement.use: Scroll reveal for the one centered statement per page.

reveal-statement.rule: Only the page's positioning statement gets 1500ms. It should feel like the room going quiet.

reveal-list.rule: Bordered lists enter from the left, the direction the arrows point. Disable below 768px (.aos-md): mobile users scroll too fast to wait.

theme-crossfade.trigger: An element with data-scroll-theme crosses the viewport midpoint
theme-crossfade.rule: Pages open dark and cross into light as the work begins. Never a hard cut.

underline.trigger: Hover on a text link (desktop, hover-capable)
underline.properties: transform: scaleX on a 0.075em currentColor bar
underline.rule: Draws in from the left and exits to the right. On touch devices the underline is always visible.

press.properties: transform: scale(0.9) for nav pills; scale(0.95) translateY(2px) for the primary CTA
press.rule: Everything you press should feel physically pressed.

cta-lift.trigger: Hover on the primary CTA band
cta-lift.properties: translateY(-4px), glow shadow, border fades to transparent
cta-lift.rule: Only one element per page gets the lift: the CTA that ends the page.

nav-autohide.rule: Hide on scroll down, return on scroll up. Content first.

tooltip-follow.trigger: Hover on a linked row (desktop only)
tooltip-follow.rule: The mono pill label names the action ('Book an intro call', 'Explore Sprints').

hero-sticky-wordmark.properties: position: sticky on the wordmark; position: sticky on the nav
hero-sticky-wordmark.rule: The wordmark starts centered, sticks to the top, and stops just above the nav (margin-bottom = nav height - 12px). The nav then pins to the top and auto-hides. Implemented as .m-hero in components.css/js.

hero-video.rule: Abstract 3D material loops behind the wordmark. Provide landscape and portrait cuts. Always have a poster frame.

reducedMotion.rule: Under prefers-reduced-motion, remove all translation and reveals and show content at rest. Color transitions may stay. Marquees slow to 50s. Hero video shows its poster frame.
